stem: British colonists objected to the Proclamation of 1763 because they —

options.label: F
options.text: feared it would provoke attacks from American Indians

options.label: G
options.text: did not want to share control of the fur trade with France

options.label: H
options.text: resented the limits it imposed on westward expansion

options.label: J
options.text: wanted to be able to trade freely with foreign nations
